A-dashboard:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high-fidelity desktop SaaS application screen, landscape 1600x1000, full flat screenshot, no device frame or perspective.
Design direction A: “潮汐工作台”, refined blue-white QQ AI robot hosting dashboard for the existing Chinese product 鱼栖 / FISHBOT CLOUD. This is a practical hosting console for ordinary users, extremely polished production-oriented UI, not a chat client.
Reference image: use ONLY the chibi 大肥鱼 / DeepSeek娘 character identity and clean illustration quality from the supplied reference, not its interface layout or name. Navy-to-cyan long wavy hair, blue eyes, small whale-fin ears, one whale tail, white frilled maid headband, modest navy-white maid dress with little whale emblem, round face, mischievous pout. Original new pose holding a small rice bowl. Keep her illustration modest, about 12% of screen area, right end of a short welcome band; tiny matching circular bot avatars.
Visual: spacious pale blue-gray canvas, white rounded 14px panels, dark navy typography, crisp thin blue borders, vivid ultramarine action buttons, seafoam status dots, subtle blue line-art wave accents. Modern legible Chinese sans-serif, excellent grid and consistent real component spacing. Beautiful but economical, airy not empty.
Precise layout: 210px left sidebar with brand “鱼栖” and small “FISHBOT CLOUD”, account workspace, active “我的机器人”, “创建机器人”; small bottom security note “模型 Key 加密保存”, account avatar and logout. Do not show administrator tools to ordinary users.
Main top breadcrumb “工作空间 / 我的机器人”, connection dot, account. Heading “我的机器人” with short supporting line “管理你的 QQ 伙伴、模型与运行状态。” and primary “＋ 创建机器人”. Small right note “设计预览 · 示例状态”.
A shallow welcome band with illustrated whale girl on the right, not a huge hero. Below it three compact genuine metrics: “我的机器人 2”, “QQ 在线 1”, “待完善 1”.
Core screen: two large side-by-side bot management cards, NOT conversations. Card 1 avatar, “大肥鱼”, “QQ 123456789”, persona “大肥鱼”; three separate labeled statuses “QQ 在线”, “AI 就绪”, “模型 已配置”. Model ID “gpt-5.6-luna”. Small “共享运行” tag. Buttons “管理配置”, “停止”, subtle “重启”. Card 2 “晚安小鱼”, “尚未绑定 QQ”, persona “自定义”; status QQ “等待扫码”, AI “已停止”, model “待配置”. Buttons “连接 QQ”, “编辑配置”, disabled-looking “启动”. Make controls tidy and intentional, don't overfill.
Bottom full-width setup row for the incomplete bot, “完成接入” with 3 ordered steps “选择人格 → 配置模型 → QQ 扫码”, and small explanatory text that login requires phone QQ confirmation. Include quiet note “列表数据为设计示例”.
Constraints: use real hosting information hierarchy. No chat transcript, no friend contact list, no mood meters, no payments, no sales charts, no video or selfie functions, no fabricated token-spend metrics. No giant illustration crowding controls. Character is recognizably DeepSeek girl rather than a fish logo. No brand 鲸屿. Crisp professional actual interface, not wireframes.
B-dashboard:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high-fidelity full desktop browser app screenshot, landscape 1600x1000, flat orthographic, no device frame.
Create a distinctly DIFFERENT direction B, “鱼栖编辑部”, for the real Chinese QQ AI bot hosting SaaS 鱼栖 / FISHBOT CLOUD. Sophisticated warm editorial design, functional cloud console with a small delightful chibi whale-girl mascot. Not a chat room or character bedroom.
Reference image is ONLY a character identity/art-style reference: round-faced 大肥鱼 / DeepSeek娘, navy/cyan blue wavy hair, blue eyes, whale-fin ears, a single whale tail, frilled white maid headband and modest navy-white whale-emblem maid dress. Keep her slightly pouty, clever, holding a rice bowl; an original new seated pose on the edge of a small help card. Illustration only 10–14% of the screen, not a central poster. Blue character contrasts with warm UI.
Art direction: ivory #f7f4ec background, creamy paper panels, near-black crisp serif display headings paired with practical sans-serif forms, muted terracotta/coral action color, hairline charcoal rules, asymmetric magazine rhythm, little numbered section labels. No blue sidebar or same card-grid layout as A. Exceptional typography and aligned controls, spacious and warm, refined not decorative scrapbook.
Layout: horizontal navigation across the top with bold brand “鱼栖”, small FISHBOT CLOUD, active “我的机器人”, “创建机器人”, right account avatar/name/“退出”. This is an ordinary user workspace, do not show admin invite management.
Title area “你的伙伴，在这里上线。” as a restrained editorial heading, subtitle “选择人格，连接 QQ，照看每个机器人的日常。” Primary coral “＋ 创建机器人” at right, small “设计预览 · 示例状态”.
Below a slim ruled summary strip “机器人 2 / QQ 在线 1 / 待完善 1”.
Main area 72% width: section 01 “我的机器人” as beautiful two-row management list, NOT cards. Each row features a small mascot portrait, robot name and persona, QQ account, separate compact status columns “QQ / AI / 模型”, and action buttons. Row 1 “大肥鱼”, “大肥鱼人格”, “123456789”, “在线 / 就绪 / 已配置”, ID “gpt-5.6-luna”, “共享运行”, actions “管理配置”, “停止”, “重启”. Row 2 “晚安小鱼”, “自定义人格”, “未绑定 QQ”, “等待扫码 / 已停止 / 待配置”, actions “连接 QQ”, “编辑配置”. Excellent clear labeled columns and generous row spacing, no pretend conversation.
Right 28% rail: small chibi whale girl above practical “接入清单” card, three steps “1 选人格 / 2 配置 URL 与 Key / 3 手机 QQ 扫码”, with the first step checked and next incomplete for the second bot. Bottom compact note “自己的 Key，自己的设定” and “数据按机器人隔离保存”.
Below list, understated support panel “配置与运行分开管理” with 3 real navigation pills “基本配置”, “QQ 连接”, “运行日志”, concise explanatory copy. Footer minimal.
Constraints: product operations dominate. No giant portrait, no chat bubbles or arbitrary chat preview, no mood/affinity statistics, no token-sales chart, no payments, no friends sidebar, no third-party Python plugin store. Brand is 鱼栖 not 鲸屿. Distinct warm editorial layout, not a recolored blue dashboard. Legible Chinese, tasteful balance.
